create.name: Dr. Amanda Hanson
create.bio:
Dr. Amanda Hanson is a clinical psychologist who has worked with women for close to thirty years and now teaches under the name Midlife Muse. Married with four children, she began by inviting women into her home for evening circles and later took the same conversations online, where she now has a large following. Her starting point is that many women are trained from childhood to put themselves last in order to fit the roles expected of them, and that midlife can be the moment to stop.

She calls her framework the Inner Authority Method. It works with eight feminine archetypes, among them the Sovereign Queen, the Wise Sage, the Erotic Oracle and the Midwife, as an inner council a woman can learn to consult in place of her inner critic, and it blends psychology with ritual and embodiment. She teaches through her 2025 book Muse, her podcast, Things Your Mother Never Told You, an online membership with monthly live calls, a six-month mastermind, live weekend events and a South Florida retreat for mothers and daughters that she leads with her daughter Ava. At Kripalu she leads a weekend on the archetypal stages of a woman's life.

videos.title: Why Are Women Hurting So Much? | Unfiltered Interview

books.title: Muse: The Magnetism of Women Who Stop Abandoning Themselves
books.author: Dr. Amanda Hanson
books.description: Her 2025 book, published by Greenleaf, argues that women are not broken but have been taught to leave themselves behind. It gives names to the patterns behind that habit and sets out the first steps of her archetype-based approach to self-trust.

courses.title: The Archetypal Journey of Womanhood
courses.description: A residential weekend at Kripalu that follows the archetypes shaping a woman's life from birth to old age. Teaching, sharing in the group and somatic practice help each participant see where she stands and take simple daily rituals home. Open to those who identify as female.

courses.title: The Muses Community
courses.description: Her online membership, running since 2022, with a monthly live call, a private app-based community and a theme each month such as money, relationships or ageing. Members also get workbooks, guided morning and evening meditations and a growing library of recordings.
courses.price: From $27 USD per month or $297 USD per year

courses.title: Mother-Daughter Retreat
courses.description: A two-day small-group retreat in South Florida for mothers and daughters, led by Amanda with her daughter Ava. Paired rituals and guided exercises, each followed by time to talk it through, help the two learn to speak openly with each other. Meals are included.

free_resources.title: 5 Questions Every Woman Eventually Has to Ask Herself
free_resources.description: A free guide built around the five questions she opens her work with. It is meant to help a reader quiet outside opinions and listen for her own sense of direction.

free_resources.title: The Queen's Communication Guide
free_resources.description: A free short training on handling hard conversations without shrinking back or attacking. It lays out a five-step way of speaking from steady authority in any close relationship.

flags: Email is a support inbox (support@amandahanson.com), published in the FAQ on the Magnetic event page; the contact page also has a general form and a team phone number.

She is a clinical psychologist and her site blends clinical psychology with feminine archetypes; her current offerings are memberships, masterminds, events and retreats rather than therapy, but a human may want to confirm she fits the 'not mainly therapy' rule.

Her podcast/YouTube channel hosts guest interviews including Kelly Brogan ('The Women Who Fear The Truth'), a psychiatrist known for vaccine-sceptical views; no anti-vaccine content was seen on Amanda's own pages, but worth a look.
Tier total sits above 1.5M, so not borderline; superhero rests on Instagram and TikTok counts read on 1 Nov 2026.
The Mother-Daughter Retreat is led with her daughter Ava Hanson; Ava is mentioned in the bio, not listed separately.
